title: Autonomy Horizon: Thresholded Apply Flow for Optimize Suggestions
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a thresholded auto-apply pipeline for Optimize batching/caching recommendations that balances cost wins with operational safety. The 'Autonomy Horizon' flow will allow lower-risk suggestions to auto-commit after a short stability window while requiring explicit approvals for larger-change families.

Scope:
- Policy engine: signal-anchored thresholds (latency p95, error rate, token cost delta) + autonomy horizon window (configurable N minutes/hours).
- Canary execution: shadow traffic canary with synthetic probes and backfilled replay simulation.
- Approval lattice: explicit operator approval for >X% throughput impact or changes touching private deployments; maintain operator escrow/rollback rights.
- Console UX: new toggle + rollout timeline UI, timeline for the autonomy horizon and instant rollback action.
- Rollback runway: multi-stage revert (instant kill, staged scale-down, config revert) with automated post-revert telemetry checks.
- Telemetry: per-route token-cost, p95 latency, KV cache hit-rate, error-rate deltas; event logs for apply/rollback with operator id.

Success criteria (internal):
- No regressions in latency or error rate in staged customers during pilot (latency p95 change < +15ms, error-rate delta < 0.05%).
- Mean cost/unit improvement >= 8% for pilot set without customer-visible regressions.
- No autoapply-induced incidents in pilot group during 14-day window.

Design decisions & trade-offs:
- Use conservative default thresholds to avoid noisy auto-commits; make heavy changes require approval.
- Autonomy horizon length trades time-to-savings vs. safety; default 2 hours with exponential shortening after repeated stable cycles.
- Synthetic canary traffic preferred to full live canary for privacy and reproducibility; shadowing used for large tenants.

Validation plan:
1) Offline replay simulation against recorded traces (nightly job).
2) Synthetic canary runs on staging with injected variability.
3) Small pilot (5-10 customers) with observability runbook and 24/7 on-call window.

Implementation tasks (high-level):
- Policy: extend optimize-policy service to support autonomy_horizon and signal anchors.
- Apply engine: add thresholded commit path and staged rollback API.
- Telemetry: new metrics and Grafana dashboards + alert rules for horizon breaches.
- Console: rollout timeline UI and operator approval modal.
- E2E tests: simulation harness and chaos test for rollback path.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: noisy signals causing flapping commits. Mitigation: signal smoothing (EWMA), min-stable-window, and commit dampening.
- Risk: operator confusion on autoapplies. Mitigation: clear UI messaging, email/oncall notifications, and a one-click revert.
